methodologyNotes: Covers stationary wood-turning lathes a hobbyist-to-pro buyer actually cross-shops in 2026 — benchtop/mini, midi, and full-size floor-standing machines from Powermatic, Laguna, JET, Nova/Teknatool, Grizzly, Rikon, Record Power, Delta, Harvey, WEN, and Oneway — each sold at a published US (or, where noted, home-market) price. Excludes metal lathes, pen-turning-only micro lathes, and CNC/robotic turning systems. Prices are current US MSRP/typical street price in USD for the bare machine as configured on the cited page (stands, chucks, and risers excluded unless factory-included); a handful of manufacturer sites (Grizzly, Delta, JET, Nova/Teknatool) block direct bot fetches, so those pages were retrieved via the Wayback Machine's live-capture proxy and are cited as such. swing_over_bed_in is the maximum workpiece diameter that clears the bed (industry-standard swing figure), in inches. distance_between_centers_in is the maximum spindle-to-tailstock working length in inches (without bed extensions). motor_power_hp is the manufacturer's published horsepower figure; null when only an amperage rating is published (no HP was estimated). speed_range_rpm is the full published spindle speed span as a string (electronically variable machines quote a single continuous span or slash-separated discrete ranges as published). variable_speed is a boolean. spindle_thread is the headstock spindle nose thread. bed_material quotes the manufacturer's own description (several premium machines use a welded steel tube bed rather than cast iron, which is called out explicitly). tailstock_taper is the Morse taper size at the tailstock quill. weight_lb is net machine weight in pounds; shipping weight is used and flagged in provenance only when no net figure is published. Record Power's Coronet Herald is a UK-market machine with no confirmed US-published MSRP at capture time, so priceUsd is null there and the GBP RRP is preserved in priceNote; every other entry converts cleanly to a real, current USD figure. accessedAt 2026-08-01 unless individually noted.

products.name: Powermatic 3520C 20" x 35" Wood Lathe
products.priceNote: Manufacturer's own price at powermatic.com: "$5,999.00" for Item# 1353001 (2 HP, 1-Ph, 220V). A Midwest Technology listing quoted a higher $6,958.00 but explicitly flagged it as special "school pricing" not available to non-school customers at that rate, so the manufacturer's own $5,999.00 is used as the representative figure.
products.provenance: Powermatic's own product page (Item# 1353001 / Model# 3520C) confirms the 2 HP, 1-Ph, 220V configuration and lists "$5,999.00" as the current price; the page's marketing copy also states the 726 lb weight (814 lb with the optional bed extension) and the sliding-headstock, electronic-variable-speed, dual-range design. Midwest Technology's dealer listing supplied the full spec block not shown on the JS-heavy manufacturer page: 20" swing over the tool rest base, 36" between centers (with dual-bearing center), 15-3,200 RPM electronic variable speed across low/high ranges, 1-1/4" x 8 TPI spindle thread, 5/8" spindle bore, MT-2 headstock and tailstock tapers, and a cast-iron bed — all consistent with Powermatic's own operator's-manual PDF for this model. The dealer's own price ($6,958.00) was explicitly marked as restricted institutional pricing and was not used.

products.name: Laguna Revo 18|36 Lathe (220V)
products.priceNote: Current US price at lagunatools.com: "$3,649" for the 220V, 2 HP configuration.
products.provenance: Laguna's own 220V product page confirms 18" swing over bed (13-1/2" over the banjo), 36" between centers, a 2 HP/220V/60Hz TEFC induction motor driven through a Delta S1 VFD giving two electronic-variable-speed ranges (50-1,300 RPM low, 135-3,500 RPM high), a 1-1/4" x 8 TPI RH spindle thread, an MT2 tailstock taper, an ASTM A36 steel bed (explicitly stated in the page's engineering-rationale copy, not cast iron), 570 lb shipping weight, and the current $3,649 price; the machine is sold only through Laguna's dealer network. FineWoodworking's 2017 review of the Revo 18|36 corroborates the model's identity and swing/centers figures and anchors the introduction to 2017. Only a shipping weight is published; no separate net weight figure was found.

products.name: JET JWL-1221VS 12" x 21" Variable Speed Wood Lathe
products.priceNote: Current US retail price "$989.99" (MSRP $1,216.26) per The Woodturning Store's BigCommerce listing (SKU JPW-719200, UPC 731325252071), matched by other JET dealers in web search results.
products.provenance: JET's own product page (Stock# JT9-719200, Model# JWL-1221VS) confirms a 12-1/2" swing over bed, 1 HP/115V motor (6A), 3/8" spindle bore, and 121.25 lb net weight (136.69 lb gross) in its spec table. The Woodturning Store's dealer listing supplies the remaining published spec block: 21" between centers, 60-3,600 RPM across three electronic-variable-speed ranges, MT2 headstock/tailstock taper, 1" x 8 TPI spindle thread, and the current $989.99 sale price against a $1,216.26 MSRP. A cast-iron bed/headstock/tailstock is stated consistently across multiple independent retailer and review sources (Shop Tool Reviews, World of Woodturning) though not spelled out verbatim on JET's own spec table.

products.name: NOVA Comet II DR Midi Lathe
products.priceNote: Manufacturer's own listed price at teknatool.com: "$599.99".
products.provenance: Teknatool's own NOVA Comet II DR product page confirms a 12"/300mm inboard swing, 16.5"/419mm standard distance between centers (extendable to 42" with an optional bed extension), a 3/4 HP 110V(US)/220V(EU) electronic-variable-speed motor with digital RPM readout spanning 250-4,000 RPM, a 1" x 8TPI RH spindle thread (US/Canada/Australasia variant; M33x3.5 RH for Europe/UK), solid cast-iron bed construction, a 2MT hollow tailstock taper with 1.6" quill travel, 84 lb weight, and the $599.99 price. KMS Tools' Canadian retail listing corroborates the model identity and supplies the manufacturer product photo used here (teknatool.com blocks direct image hotlinking).

products.name: Grizzly G0766 22" x 42" Variable-Speed Wood Lathe
products.priceNote: Manufacturer's own price at grizzly.com: "$2,895.00" (msrp/listPrice/price all match) for Item# G0766.
products.provenance: Grizzly's own product page (fetched via the Wayback Machine's live-capture proxy because grizzly.com returns HTTP 403 to direct fetches) confirms the exact unit — "Grizzly G0766 - 22\" x 42\" Variable-Speed Wood Lathe" — with a full spec block: 3 HP/240V single-phase motor driven through a VFD for electronic variable speed (100-1,200 RPM low range, 330-3,200 RPM high range, combined 100-3,200 RPM), 22" swing over bed (18" over the tool rest base), 42" between centers, 1-1/4" x 8 TPI RH spindle thread, MT#2 spindle and tailstock taper, a heavy-duty cast-iron bed and stand, and an approximate shipping weight of 524 lbs (no separate net weight is published). The page's embedded pricing data (msrp/listPrice/price all $2,895.00) matches the product image hash used here, confirming the price and photo both belong to this exact model rather than a sibling variant.

products.name: Rikon 70-220VSR 12-1/2" x 20" Midi VSR Lathe
products.priceNote: Rikon sells only through dealers and publishes no direct price. $649.99 is Woodcraft's listed price for Item #861205 (Rikon 70-220VSR Midi Lathe), captured via an Aug 2025 Wayback Machine snapshot of Woodcraft's product page; this is the only current-ish retail price found and should be treated as an anchor/typical street price rather than a guaranteed up-to-the-day figure.
products.provenance: Rikon's own operator's manual (Model 70-220VSR, revision 70-220VSRM6) publishes the full spec table: 1 HP, 120V/1Ph/6A/60Hz motor rated 2,900 RPM no-load; 12-1/2" swing over bed (9-5/8" over the tool rest base); 20" distance between centers; three electronic-variable-speed ranges (250-750 / 550-1,650 / 1,300-3,850 RPM); 1" x 8 TPI spindle nose thread; MT-2 headstock and tailstock taper; a cast base; and 115 lb net weight. Woodcraft's product page (Item #861205) independently reproduces the identical spec block verbatim and lists a current price of $649.99 with the item marked active/in-stock. No freely licensed, directly fetchable product photo was found (Rikon's own site serves only parts-diagram imagery for this legacy SKU and Woodcraft's own image path 404s on the live site), so the image field is omitted rather than guessed.

products.name: Record Power Coronet Herald Heavy Duty Cast Iron Electronic Variable Speed Lathe
products.priceNote: UK-market machine: manufacturer's own recordpower.co.uk price is £899.99 GBP. No confirmed, currently-published US-market MSRP was found at capture time, so priceUsd is left null rather than converting currency into a fabricated USD figure.
products.provenance: Record Power's own UK product page confirms the full spec block: max swing over bed 355mm (14"), max between centres 508mm (20"), max outboard bowl diameter 533mm (21"), spindle speeds 95-3,890 RPM via full electronic variable speed, motor input/output 1kW/0.75kW, M33 spindle thread, 2 Morse taper tailstock, cast-iron bed (confirmed as a ticked product attribute), 48kg (105.8 lb) weight, and a current price of £899.99. Record Power is a UK brand sold through UK/EU dealers; no US distributor listing with its own published USD price was located, so priceUsd is honestly left null rather than applying a currency conversion the manufacturer never published.

products.name: Delta 46-460 12-1/2 In. Variable-Speed Midi Lathe
products.priceNote: Delta sells through dealers and publishes no direct price on deltamachinery.com. $1,199.99 is Acme Tools' listed price (in stock), captured via an Aug 2025 Wayback Machine snapshot of its product page (SKU 847962000026, MPN 46-460).
products.provenance: Delta's own product page (fetched via the Wayback Machine because deltamachinery.com blocks direct bot fetches) confirms the full spec list: 1 HP max, 1,725 RPM motor; 120V/1Ph/60Hz; three electronic-variable-speed ranges (250-700 / 600-1,800 / 1,350-4,000 RPM); 12-1/2" swing over bed (9-9/16" over the base); 16-1/2" distance between centers (42" with the optional extension); 1" x 8 RH TPI drive spindle thread; #2 MT head- and tailstock taper; all cast-iron construction; and a 97 lb net weight (106 lb shipping). Acme Tools' archived product listing independently confirms the identical model (MPN/SKU 46-460) and its embedded schema.org Offer data gives the current $1,199.99 price and the manufacturer product photo used here.

products.name: Harvey Turbo T-40 14" x 24" Wood Lathe with Servo Motor
products.priceNote: Current sale price $2,599.00 (list/compare-at price $2,799.00) per harveywoodworking.com's own Shopify product data.
products.provenance: Harvey's own product page confirms the T-40's 220V industrial servo spindle motor rated up to 3 HP peak (12.54 Nm) with continuous electronic variable speed from 60-4,300 RPM (2-microsecond drive response), 14" (360mm) swing over the bed, 24" (610mm) distance between centers, a headstock that swivels up to 90°, a solid cast-iron bed ("machined and ground like the T40 bed itself" per the optional outrigger's own description), and 178 lb (80kg) weight. The page's embedded Shopify product JSON gives the current sale price of $2,599.00 against a $2,799.00 list price. No spindle-thread size or tailstock Morse-taper figure is stated anywhere on the manufacturer's page, so both are left null rather than assumed from other Harvey models.

products.name: Laguna Revo 12|16 Lathe
products.priceNote: Current visible price on lagunatools.com is $1,099 (the page's embedded schema.org product data separately carries a stale cached $999 figure dated priceValidUntil 2024-06-14; the on-page displayed price of $1,099 is used as more current).
products.provenance: Laguna's own Revo 12|16 product page publishes the full "Additional Details" spec block: a 1 HP DC motor controlled by pulse-width modulation across three ranges (50-525 low / 325-1,750 mid / 650-3,500 high RPM), 12-1/2" swing over bed (9-1/2" over the banjo, 16" max outboard swing), 15-1/2" distance between centers, a 1" x 8 TPI spindle thread at both ends, MT#2 tailstock quill, and 118 lb net weight (125 lb shipping). No bed-material claim (cast iron vs. steel) is made anywhere on this specific product page, unlike Laguna's larger Revo 18|36 which explicitly documents an ASTM A36 steel bed, so bed_material is left null here rather than assumed to match the sibling model.

products.name: WEN LA3421 3.2-Amp 8" x 13" Variable Speed Mini Benchtop Wood Lathe
products.provenance: WEN's own product page and its linked owner's manual (Model LA3421) both confirm the identical spec table: 120V/60Hz/3.2A motor (no HP figure is published, only amperage), 8" swing over the bed, 13" distance between centers, 750-3,200 RPM electronic variable speed, MT1 spindle taper, 1" x 8 TPI spindle thread, MT1 tailstock taper, 4-1/2"/7" interchangeable tool rests, 45 lb weight, and the current $244.87 price. The manual's maintenance section states the lathe "is made from steel and cast iron," which is used verbatim for bed_material rather than assuming pure cast iron.

products.name: Oneway 2436 Lathe
products.priceNote: $6,776.95 per Oneway's own oneway.ca price (2000 Series Lathe, Item No. 2436 row), independently matched exactly by Packard Woodworks, a US dealer, confirming this is a genuine current USD street price rather than a CAD figure.
products.provenance: Oneway's own 2000 Series Lathe page lists the 2436 variant's own row (Item No. 2436): 36" distance between centers, 60" overall length, 24" swing over bed, 850 lb approximate weight, and the current $6,776.95 price. The same page's engineering description (shared across the whole 2000 Series family the 2436 belongs to) documents a welded 10-3/4" dia. x 5/16" wall steel tube bed (explicitly contrasted with "twin tube or cast iron bed designs"), a 20-800/190-1900/305-3050 RPM three-range AC electronic-variable-speed drive (1.5, 2, or 3 HP motor options), an M33 x 3.5 spindle thread with #2 Morse taper at the headstock inboard, and a #3 Morse taper tailstock quill with 4" travel. Packard Woodworks, a US Oneway dealer, independently lists the identical 2436 model at the identical $6,776.95 price, confirming the figure is a real current USD price rather than an unconverted CAD list price.
